description:
Elah is a Bible you can see. It draws every cross reference in Scripture as one map of arcs, sets Gustave Doré's engravings at the chapters they illustrate, and opens on David and Goliath in the valley of Elah.

The Map
Every chapter from Genesis to Revelation is a bar along the bottom. Every arc joins two chapters that quote or echo each other, coloured by how far it reaches: gold for neighbours, blue for links that span the whole Bible. Drag along the chapters to light one up, then open any chapter it reaches. 7,000 links from OpenBible.info.

The Engravings
Doré's 1866 Bible plates, set as blue halftone prints at the head of their chapters: David and Goliath, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Samson, Daniel and more. Browse them all on Today.

Nine Bibles, offline
The King James, the Berean Standard, the American Standard, the New Heart, Young's Literal, Darby, Webster, the Bible in Basic English and the 1599 Geneva. All public domain, all on your device.

Read, listen, keep
Any book and chapter from the reference at the top. Your device reads any chapter aloud and outlines the verse it is on. Highlight in four colours, bookmark, write notes, share a verse as an image card. Search every verse offline, with exact phrases in quotes.

Today
Pick up where you left off, follow a reading plan, or start with the verse of the day.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your highlights and notes stay on your device.
